summary: Hesai Group filed a Form 6-K announcing a board meeting scheduled for May 19, 2026, to consider and approve its unaudited quarterly results for the three months ended March 31, 2026, and its publication. The filing includes details for an earnings conference call and a live webcast. This is a routine announcement of an upcoming board meeting to review financial results, not a special situation event. No special-situation terms, transactions, or structural changes are mentioned. There are no deal terms to report.
